DA_AdvancedLoan.name: 高级贷款
DA_AdvancedLoan.desc: 获得20金币。你的下一个强化符文位阶降低一阶。
DA_AdvancedLoan.desc_en: Gain 20 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.name: 高级贷款+
DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.desc: 获得33金币。你的下一个强化符文位阶降低一阶。
DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.desc_en: Gain 33 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_ArcaneViktory.name: 双城赢家
DA_ArcaneViktory.desc: After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat.
DA_ArcaneViktory.desc_en: After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat.

DA_Ascension.name: 飞升
DA_Ascension.desc: 在战斗开始12秒后，你的单位们获得35%伤害增幅。
DA_Ascension.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 35% Damage Amp.

DA_AugmentedPower.name: 强化之能量
DA_AugmentedPower.desc: 你的下一个强化符文位阶提高一阶。
DA_AugmentedPower.desc_en: Your next augment is one tier higher.

DA_BacklineBlueprint.name: 后排蓝图
DA_BacklineBlueprint.desc: 获得1个3费非坦克弈子，以及一个与其职业相匹配的纹章。
DA_BacklineBlueprint.desc_en: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_BackupBows.name: 战时补给：反曲之弓
DA_BackupBows.desc: 获得1个【反曲之弓】。在你的弈子们攻击1000次后，额外获得2个。
DA_BackupBows.desc_en: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack 1000 times, get 2 more.

DA_BandOfThievesII.name: 窃贼帮派 II
DA_BandOfThievesII.desc: 获得2个【窃贼手套】。在5场玩家对战回合后，获得另一个。
DA_BandOfThievesII.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.name: 窃贼帮派 II+
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.desc: 获得2个【窃贼手套】。在5场玩家对战回合后，获得另一个。
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.name: 窃贼帮派 II++
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.desc: 获得2个【窃贼手套】。在3场玩家对战回合后，获得另一个。
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain another.

DA_BaronsLair.name: 男爵幻域
DA_BaronsLair.desc: 获得1件随机坦克装备。在战斗开始8秒后，你的队伍每秒获得4%额外物理加成和法术加成，持续至战斗结束。
DA_BaronsLair.desc_en: Gain a random Tank item. After 8 seconds of combat, your team gains 4% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

DA_BeltOverflow.name: 腰带溢流
DA_BeltOverflow.desc: 获得4个【巨人腰带】。你的【巨人腰带】提供+85额外生命值。
DA_BeltOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +85 bonus Health.

DA_18_BigGrabBag.name: 大百宝袋
DA_18_BigGrabBag.desc: 获得3件随机基础装备、2金币和1个【装备重铸器】。
DA_18_BigGrabBag.desc_en: Gain 3 random components, 2 gold, and 1 Reforger.

DA_BirthdayPresent.name: 生日礼物
DA_BirthdayPresent.desc: 在你每次升级时提供1个2星弈子和1金币。这个弈子的费用位阶是你的等级减4(最大值：5费)。
DA_BirthdayPresent.desc_en: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

DA_BirthdayReunion.name: 生日聚会
DA_BirthdayReunion.desc: 获得1个随机2星2费弈子。在6级时，获得1件随机基础装备。在9级时，获得1个随机2星5费弈子。
DA_BirthdayReunion.desc_en: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level 6, gain a random item component. At Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

DA_BlackthornTraitAugment.name: 装备提炼
DA_BlackthornTraitAugment.desc: 你最初3次在【黑荆棘格】内献祭1个弈子时，获得1个其携带着的随机散件的复制品。获得1个【阿兹尔】、1个【维迦】和1个【雷克塞】。
DA_BlackthornTraitAugment.desc_en: The first 3 times you sacrifice a champion in the Blackthorn hex, gain a copy of a random component they're holding. Gain an Azir, Veigar, and a Rek'Sai.

DA_18_BlossomTraitAugment.name: 绽灵花的约定
DA_18_BlossomTraitAugment.desc: 当你购买1个【自然仙灵】时，获得1个随机【灵魂莲华】弈子(基于【自然仙灵】的费用)。获得1个【芸阿娜】、1个【约里克】和1个【卡尔玛】。
DA_18_BlossomTraitAugment.desc_en: When you buy a Wisp, gain a random Blossom champion based on the Wisp's cost. Gain a Yunara, a Yorick, and a Karma.

DA_BodyguardTraining.name: 利落保镖
DA_BodyguardTraining.desc: 友军获得15护甲和魔法抗性，每玩家等级提升该加成2。 2022【双城之战】全球总决赛
DA_BodyguardTraining.desc_en: Allies gain 15 Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 2 per player level.

DA_BonusGift.name: 意外之礼
DA_BonusGift.desc: 每当你开启1个战利品法球时，你有25%几率获得1个灰色战利品法球。获得1个灰色战利品法球。
DA_BonusGift.desc_en: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 1 gray loot orbs.

DA_BonusGiftPlus.name: 意外之礼+
DA_BonusGiftPlus.desc: 每当你开启1个战利品法球时，你有25%几率获得1个灰色战利品法球。获得2个灰色战利品法球。
DA_BonusGiftPlus.desc_en: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 2 gray loot orbs.

DA_BoosterPack.name: 扩展包
DA_BoosterPack.desc: 获得价值12金币的随机弈子。(保证至少一个3费弈子！)
DA_BoosterPack.desc_en: Gain 12 gold of random champions. (At least one 3-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlus.name: 扩展包+
DA_BoosterPackPlus.desc: 获得价值18金币的随机弈子。(保证至少一个4费弈子！)
DA_BoosterPackPlus.desc_en: Gain 18 gold of random champions. (At least one 4-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.name: 扩展包++
DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.desc: 获得价值26金币的随机弈子。(保证至少一个5费弈子！)
DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 26 gold of random champions. (At least one 5-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoxingLessons.name: 拳击课程
DA_BoxingLessons.desc: 战斗开始时，前排每有1个弈子，你的队伍获得30生命值。
DA_BoxingLessons.desc_en: Your team gains 30 Health for each champion that starts combat in the front row.

DA_18_BranchingOutPlus.name: 节外生枝+
DA_18_BranchingOutPlus.desc: 获得1个随机纹章和1个【装备重铸器】。
DA_18_BranchingOutPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

DA_BronzeForLifeI.name: 终身黄铜 I
DA_BronzeForLifeI.desc: 每拥有1个黄铜级羁绊，你的队伍获得2.5%伤害增幅。
DA_BronzeForLifeI.desc_en: Your team gains 2.5% Damage Amp for each Bronze-tier trait.

DA_BronzeForLifeII.name: 终身黄铜 II
DA_BronzeForLifeII.desc: 每拥有1个黄铜级羁绊，你的队伍获得2.5%伤害增幅和4护甲与魔法抗性。
DA_BronzeForLifeII.desc_en: Your team gains 2.5% Damage Amp and 4 Armor and Magic Resist for each Bronze-tier trait.

DA_BuriedTreasuresIII.name: 珍藏财宝 III
DA_BuriedTreasuresIII.desc: 立刻以及接下来的6个回合开始时，获得1件随机基础装备。
DA_BuriedTreasuresIII.desc_en: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next 6 rounds.

DA_CalledShot.name: 进攻宣告
DA_CalledShot.desc: 将你的连胜数设为+4。获得4金币。
DA_CalledShot.desc_en: Set your win streak to +4. Gain 4 gold.

DA_CallToChaos.name: 混沌召唤
DA_CallToChaos.desc: 获得1个强大的随机奖励。
DA_CallToChaos.desc_en: Gain a powerful and random reward.

DA_CapitalGainsI.name: 资本利得 I
DA_CapitalGainsI.desc: 储存相当于你获得利息的金币。在阶段3-3，获得相当于你100已储存金币的金币。立刻获得1金币。
DA_CapitalGainsI.desc_en: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 100% of the stored gold. Gain 1 gold now.

DA_CapitalGainsII.name: 资本利得 II
DA_CapitalGainsII.desc: 储存相当于你获得利息的金币。在阶段3-3，获得相当于你125已储存金币的金币。立刻获得3金币。
DA_CapitalGainsII.desc_en: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 125% of the stored gold. Gain 3 gold now.

DA_18_CaretakersAlly.name: 游神的盟友
DA_18_CaretakersAlly.desc: 立刻获得1个随机2费弈子。在你每次升级时，再次获得1个相同弈子。
DA_18_CaretakersAlly.desc_en: Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up.

DA_CaretakersFavor.name: 游神的眷顾
DA_CaretakersFavor.desc: 在你到达5、6、7和8级时，获得1个【基础装备锻造器】。
DA_CaretakersFavor.desc_en: Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8.

DA_CarveAPath.name: 战时补给：暴风大剑
DA_CarveAPath.desc: 获得1个【暴风大剑】。在你的弈子们造成65000物理伤害后，额外获得2个。
DA_CarveAPath.desc_en: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal 65000 physical damage, gain 2 more.

DA_CelestialBlessingI.name: 星界赐福 I
DA_CelestialBlessingI.desc: 你的队伍获得12%全能吸血。溢出的治疗量会转换为护盾，至多转化为200生命值护盾。
DA_CelestialBlessingI.desc_en: Your team gains 12% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 200 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingII.name: 星界赐福 II
DA_CelestialBlessingII.desc: 你的队伍获得18%全能吸血。溢出的治疗量会转换为护盾，至多转化为400生命值护盾。
DA_CelestialBlessingII.desc_en: Your team gains 18% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 400 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingIII.name: 星界赐福 III
DA_CelestialBlessingIII.desc: 你的队伍获得25%全能吸血。溢出的治疗量会转换为护盾，至多转化为1000生命值护盾。
DA_CelestialBlessingIII.desc_en: Your team gains 25% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 1000 Health.

DA_ChampDelivery.name: 弈子配送
DA_ChampDelivery.desc: 获得3个2费弈子。在6个回合后，再获得3个。
DA_ChampDelivery.desc_en: Gain 3 2-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.name: 弈子配送+
DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.desc: 获得3个3费弈子。在6个回合后，再获得3个。
DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.desc_en: Gain 3 3-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.name: 弈子配送++
DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.desc: 获得3个4费弈子。在6个回合后，再获得3个。
DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 3 4-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ClearMind.name: 清晰头脑
DA_ClearMind.desc: 如果在玩家对战回合结束时，你的备战席没有任何弈子，则获得3经验值。
DA_ClearMind.desc_en: If there are no champions on your bench at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_ClockworkAccelerator.name: 发条增速器
DA_ClockworkAccelerator.desc: 你的队伍在战斗中每过3秒就会获得10%攻击速度。
DA_ClockworkAccelerator.desc_en: Your team gains 10% Attack Speed every 3 seconds in combat.

DA_ClutteredMind.name: 纷乱头脑
DA_ClutteredMind.desc: 立刻获得4个1费弈子。如果在玩家对战回合结束时，你的备战席已满，则获得3经验值。
DA_ClutteredMind.desc_en: Gain 4 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_CognitiveOverload.name: 认知过载
DA_CognitiveOverload.desc: 获得7金币、1个2星1费弈子、1个2费弈子、2个3费弈子、1经验值以及1次商店刷新。
DA_CognitiveOverload.desc_en: Gain 7 gold, 1 2-star 1-cost champion, 1 2-cost champion, 2 3-cost champions, 1 XP, and 1 Shop reroll.

DA_ComebackStory.name: 绝境反击
DA_ComebackStory.desc: 每损失1玩家生命值，你的队伍获得4生命值和0.3%攻击速度。
DA_ComebackStory.desc_en: Your team gains 4 Health and 0.3% Attack Speed per missing player Health.

DA_CommerceCore.name: 贸易中心
DA_CommerceCore.desc: 立刻获得16次免费商店刷新，并在剩余游戏时间内每回合获得3次免费商店刷新。
DA_CommerceCore.desc_en: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

DA_ComponentBuffet.name: 基础装备自助餐
DA_ComponentBuffet.desc: 每当你将要获得1件基础装备时，转而获得1个【基础装备锻造器】。获得1件随机基础装备。这个锻造器提供4个选项。
DA_ComponentBuffet.desc_en: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component.The anvil offers 4 choices.

DA_ComponentQuest.name: 基础装备大冒险
DA_ComponentQuest.desc: 获得1件随机基础装备和1金币。下7次你赢得玩家对战回合时，获得1件不同的随机基础装备。在此之后，获得5金币。
DA_ComponentQuest.desc_en: Gain a random component and 1 gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain 5 gold.

DA_CookingPot.name: 金色炊具
DA_CookingPot.desc: 在每回合开始时，所有持有【金锅锅】或【金铲铲】装备的友军都会为最近的弈子提供60永久生命值。获得1个【金锅锅】。
DA_CookingPot.desc_en: At the start of each turn, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion 60 permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

DA_Coronation.name: 加冕礼
DA_Coronation.desc: 获得1个【金铲铲冠冕】。【金铲铲冠冕】、【金锅锅冠冕】和【金锅铲冠冕】为携带者提供20%攻击速度、25%物理加成和30%法术加成。
DA_Coronation.desc_en: Gain a Tactician's Crown. Tactician's Crown, Cape, and Shield grant the holder 20% Attack Speed, 25% Attack Damage, and 30% Ability Power.

DA_Corrosion.name: 腐蚀
DA_Corrosion.desc: 前两排的敌人每2秒损失4护甲和魔法抗性。
DA_Corrosion.desc_en: Enemies in the first two rows lose 4 Armor and Magic Resist every 2 seconds.

DA_18_CovenTraitAugment.name: 女巫使魔
DA_18_CovenTraitAugment.desc: 当你选择继续收集【魔女精粹】而非兑换时，治疗2玩家生命值。获得1个【卡蜜尔】、1个【伊莉丝】和1个【凯特琳】。
DA_18_CovenTraitAugment.desc_en: When you choose to continue gathering Coven essence, heal 2 Tactician health. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

DA_CraftedCrafting.name: 精心打造
DA_CraftedCrafting.desc: 每当你打造1件成装时，获得2次刷新。
DA_CraftedCrafting.desc_en: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

DA_CryMeARiver.name: 泪流成河
DA_CryMeARiver.desc: 获得1个【女神之泪】。你的队伍获得1法力回复。战斗开始12秒后，该数值提升至4。
DA_CryMeARiver.desc_en: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. After 12 seconds in combat, increase this to 4.

DA_DeadlierBlades.name: 更要命的战刃
DA_DeadlierBlades.desc: 获得1个【死亡之刃】。【死亡之刃】的携带者每参与1次击杀，【死亡之刃】就会永久获得1%物理加成。
DA_DeadlierBlades.desc_en: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain 1% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_Dummify.name: 假人化
DA_Dummify.desc: 失去你棋盘上和备战席的所有弈子。获得1个【训练假人】，其生命值为所有失去弈子总生命值的60%。假人每阶段获得1150生命值。获得1个随机2星2费非坦克弈子。
DA_Dummify.desc_en: Lose all champions on your board and bench. Gain a Training Dummy with 60% of their combined health. The dummy gains 1150 Health per stage. Gain a random non-tank 2-star 2 cost champion.

DA_18_DuoQueue.name: 双排
DA_18_DuoQueue.desc: 获得2个随机5费弈子和2件相同的随机基础装备。
DA_18_DuoQueue.desc_en: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.

DA_EarlyLearnings.name: 宝宝学院
DA_EarlyLearnings.desc: 你的队伍获得5%物理加成和法术加成。在每场玩家对战回合结束后，该加成提升1%。1费弈子们获得双倍该加成。
DA_EarlyLearnings.desc_en: Your team gains 5% Attack Damage & Ability Power. This increases by 1% after each player combat. 1-cost champions gain double.

DA_18_ElderwoodTraitAugment.name: 自然庇护所
DA_18_ElderwoodTraitAugment.desc: 战斗开始时：位于【永恒之森】植物邻格的弈子们获得15%攻击速度，并且每2秒治疗其2%最大生命值。获得1个【阿利斯塔】、1个【奥恩】和1个【霞】。
DA_18_ElderwoodTraitAugment.desc_en: Champions that start combat adjacent to an Elderwood plant gain 15% Attack Speed and heal 2% of their maximum Health every 2 seconds. Gain an Alistar, an Ornn, and a Xayah.

DA_ElectrochargeI.name: 电火花 I
DA_ElectrochargeI.desc: 友军每受到4次攻击，会对附近的敌人造成30~90(基于当前阶段)魔法伤害(1秒冷却)。
DA_ElectrochargeI.desc_en: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 30-90 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_ElectrochargeII.name: 电火花 II
DA_ElectrochargeII.desc: 友军每受到4次攻击，会对附近的敌人造成50~140(基于当前阶段)魔法伤害(1秒冷却)。
DA_ElectrochargeII.desc_en: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 50-140 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_EpicRolldown.name: 8级D干的传说
DA_EpicRolldown.desc: 在你到达8级时，获得20次商店刷新。
DA_EpicRolldown.desc_en: When you reach Level 8, gain 20 Shop rerolls.

DA_Epoch.name: 新纪元
DA_Epoch.desc: 立刻以及每阶段开始时，获得4经验值和2次免费刷新。
DA_Epoch.desc_en: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 4 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_EpochPlus.name: 新纪元+
DA_EpochPlus.desc: 立刻以及每阶段开始时，获得8经验值和2次免费刷新。
DA_EpochPlus.desc_en: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 8 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_ExclusiveCustomization.name: 专属定制
DA_ExclusiveCustomization.desc: 获得1个【幸运装备宝箱】、1个【装备拆卸器】和7金币。
DA_ExclusiveCustomization.desc_en: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and 7 gold.

DA_Expedition.name: 远征
DA_Expedition.desc: 在每回合开始时，失去备战席最右侧栏位的弈子。当你通过这种方式失去的弈子总价值达到33金币时，获得强力奖励。立刻获得1个3费弈子。
DA_Expedition.desc_en: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing 33 gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

DA_ExplosiveGrowth.name: 爆炸式增长
DA_ExplosiveGrowth.desc: 立刻以及接下来的3个回合开始时，获得7经验值。
DA_ExplosiveGrowth.desc_en: Now and at the start of the next 3 rounds, gain 7 XP.

DA_ExplosiveGrowthPlus.name: 爆炸式增长+
DA_ExplosiveGrowthPlus.desc: 立刻以及接下来的3个回合开始时，获得10经验值。
DA_ExplosiveGrowthPlus.desc_en: Now and at the start of the next 3 rounds, gain 10 XP.

DA_ExtraBuckles.name: 战时补给：巨人腰带
DA_ExtraBuckles.desc: 获得1个【巨人腰带】。在你的弈子们承受75000伤害后，额外获得2个。
DA_ExtraBuckles.desc_en: Gain a Giant's Belt. After your champions take 75000 damage, get 2 more.

DA_18_FaeTraitAugment.name: 巨化术
DA_18_FaeTraitAugment.desc: 【花仙子】弈子的【皮克斯仙灵】体型变大，并提供50%额外物理加成和法术加成。【花仙子】弈子们立刻获得10%物理加成和法术加成。获得1个【霞】和1个【洛】。
DA_18_FaeTraitAugment.desc_en: Fae pixies are now larger and grant 50% more Attack Damage and Ability Power. Fae champions gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power immediately. Gain a Xayah and a Rakan.

DA_FeelingLucky.name: 手气不错
DA_FeelingLucky.desc: 获得12金币，然后抛掷1枚硬币。如果硬币正面朝上，额外获得4金币。
DA_FeelingLucky.desc_en: Gain 12 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 4 more gold.

DA_FindYourCenter.name: C位的觉悟
DA_FindYourCenter.desc: 战斗开始时，位于棋盘中心的那个己方弈子获得15%伤害增幅和25%最大生命值。
DA_FindYourCenter.desc_en: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 25% max Health.

DA_Flexible.name: 灵活摇摆
DA_Flexible.desc: 获得1个随机纹章。在每阶段开始时，获得1个随机纹章。你的队伍每携带1个纹章，就会获得30生命值。
DA_Flexible.desc_en: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains 30 Health for each Emblem they are holding.

DA_18_FloraFatalisAugment.name: 致命丽花
DA_18_FloraFatalisAugment.desc: 获得1个【绝命花妖纹章】。携带该纹章的弈子从【绝命花妖】羁绊中获得50%额外加成。获得3金币。
DA_18_FloraFatalisAugment.desc_en: Gain a Flora Fatalis emblem. The champion holding the emblem gains 50% increased benefits from Flora Fatalis. Gain 3 gold.

DA_FlowingTears.name: 战时补给：女神之泪
DA_FlowingTears.desc: 获得1个【女神之泪】。在你的弈子们消耗6500法力值后，额外获得2个。
DA_FlowingTears.desc_en: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend 6500 Mana, gain 2 more.

DA_FocusedFire.name: 集中火力
DA_FocusedFire.desc: 你的队伍获得10%物理加成。每5秒，额外获得5%。
DA_FocusedFire.desc_en: Your team gains 10% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 5% more.

DA_ForgedInStrength.name: 神力天铸
DA_ForgedInStrength.desc: 获得1件随机神器。当你降至35生命值时，额外获得1件随机神器、1件随机成装、以及2件随机基础装备。
DA_ForgedInStrength.desc_en: Gain 1 random Artifact. When you drop below 35 Health, gain 1 more random Artifact, 1 random completed item, and 2 random components.

DA_18_FOURcing.name: 四之力
DA_18_FOURcing.desc: 获得1个随机4费弈子。该弈子每携带1件装备，你的队伍获得100生命值。
DA_18_FOURcing.desc_en: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains 100 health.

DA_FrontlineFoundation.name: 前线地基
DA_FrontlineFoundation.desc: 获得1个2星1费坦克弈子，以及一个与其职业相匹配的纹章。
DA_FrontlineFoundation.desc_en: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_FutureFocused.name: 高瞻远瞩
DA_FutureFocused.desc: 你失去20玩家生命值，但在5个玩家对战回合后，获得3个4费弈子和8金币。
DA_FutureFocused.desc_en: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 5 player combats, gain 3 4-cost champions and 8 gold.

DA_GiantAndMighty.name: 大而有力
DA_GiantAndMighty.desc: 你的队伍体型变大，获得200生命值和10%最大生命值。
DA_GiantAndMighty.desc_en: Your team becomes large, gaining 200 Health and 10% max Health.

DA_GildedSteel.name: 镀金钢铁
DA_GildedSteel.desc: 获得2个5费弈子。如果你登场了至少一个5费弈子，你的1至4费弈子们获得8%伤害减免。
DA_GildedSteel.desc_en: Gain two 5-cost champions. If you field at least one 5-cost champion, your 1 to 4-cost champions gain 8% Durability.

DA_GlassCannon_Gold.name: 玻璃大炮 II
DA_GlassCannon_Gold.desc: 在后排开始战斗的友军，在战斗开始时的生命值为80%，但会获得25%伤害增幅。
DA_GlassCannon_Gold.desc_en: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 25% Damage Amp.

DA_GlassCannon_Silver.name: 玻璃大炮 I
DA_GlassCannon_Silver.desc: 在后排开始战斗的友军，在战斗开始时的生命值为80%，但会获得16%伤害增幅。
DA_GlassCannon_Silver.desc_en: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 16% Damage Amp.

DA_GoingLong.name: 遥遥领先
DA_GoingLong.desc: 你不再获得利息。立刻获得10金币。在每场玩家对战后，获得4经验值。 10
DA_GoingLong.desc_en: You no longer gain interest. Gain 10 gold now. Gain 4 XP after every player combat. 10

DA_GoldenEgg.name: 金蛋
DA_GoldenEgg.desc: 获得1个大金蛋，需要11个回合来孵化，在孵化时提供大量战利品。赢得玩家对战回合后会使孵化倒计时加快1个额外回合。
DA_GoldenEgg.desc_en: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

DA_GoldenGamble.name: 黄金赌约
DA_GoldenGamble.desc: 获得2金币，并抛掷1枚硬币。如果硬币正面朝上，获得1个【光明版幸运装备宝箱】。如果硬币反面朝上，获得2个【成装锻造器】。
DA_GoldenGamble.desc_en: Gain 2 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlus.name: 黄金赌约+
DA_GoldenGamblePlus.desc: 获得3金币，并抛掷1枚硬币。如果硬币正面朝上，获得1个【光明版幸运装备宝箱】。如果硬币反面朝上，获得2个【成装锻造器】。
DA_GoldenGamblePlus.desc_en: Gain 3 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.name: 黄金赌约++
DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.desc: 获得6金币，并抛掷1枚硬币。如果硬币正面朝上，获得1个【光明版幸运装备宝箱】。如果硬币反面朝上，获得2个【成装锻造器】。
DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 6 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_18_GoodForSomethingI.name: 有用之材 I
DA_18_GoodForSomethingI.desc: 未携带装备的弈子们在阵亡时有40%几率掉落1金币。
DA_18_GoodForSomethingI.desc_en: Champions that aren't holding items have a 40% chance to drop 1 gold on death.

DA_GroupHugI.name: 拥抱 I
DA_GroupHugI.desc: 战斗开始时：弈子为其他邻格弈子提供6护甲和魔抗。这个效果可以叠加。
DA_GroupHugI.desc_en: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions 6 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_GroupHugII.name: 拥抱 II
DA_GroupHugII.desc: 战斗开始时：弈子为其他邻格弈子提供9护甲和魔抗。这个效果可以叠加。
DA_GroupHugII.desc_en: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions 9 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_HardBargain.name: 砍价高手
DA_HardBargain.desc: 你无法选择你的选秀奖励。每次选秀回合获得额外的6玩家生命值和8金币。
DA_HardBargain.desc_en: You cannot choose your Carousel rewards. Gain an additional 6 player health and 8 gold each carousel round.

DA_HardCommit.name: 硬性承诺
DA_HardCommit.desc: 获得1个随机纹章。立刻以及每阶段开始时，获得该羁绊的1个1星弈子，且该弈子的费用相当于当前阶段数(最多为5)，并获得3金币。
DA_HardCommit.desc_en: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

DA_HealingOrbsI.name: 治疗法球 I
DA_HealingOrbsI.desc: 当1名敌人阵亡时，1名附近的友军治疗250生命值。
DA_HealingOrbsI.desc_en: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 250 Health.

DA_HealingOrbsII.name: 治疗法球 II
DA_HealingOrbsII.desc: 当1名敌人阵亡时，1名附近的友军治疗575生命值。
DA_HealingOrbsII.desc_en: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 575 Health.

DA_HeartOfSteel.name: 心之钢
DA_HeartOfSteel.desc: 获得1个【坚定之心】。【坚定之心】的携带者每存活10秒，【坚定之心】就会额外获得16永久最大生命值。
DA_HeartOfSteel.desc_en: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every 10 seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional 16 permanent max Health.

DA_HedgeFund.name: 对冲基金
DA_HedgeFund.desc: 获得22金币。你的最大利息提升至10金币。
DA_HedgeFund.desc_en: Gain 22 gold. Your max interest is increased to 10.

DA_HeroicGrabBag.name: 英勇福袋
DA_HeroicGrabBag.desc: 获得2个【次级英雄复制器】。获得4金币。
DA_HeroicGrabBag.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 4 gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlus.name: 英勇福袋+
DA_HeroicGrabBagPlus.desc: 获得2个【次级英雄复制器】。获得8金币。
DA_HeroicGrabBagPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 8 gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlusPlus.name: 英勇福袋++
DA_HeroicGrabBagPlusPlus.desc: 获得2个【次级英雄复制器】。获得14金币。
DA_HeroicGrabBagPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 14 gold.

DA_HoldTheLine.name: 坚守防线
DA_HoldTheLine.desc: 战斗开始时，你的前排每有1名弈子，后两排的弈子就会获得10%法术加成和9%物理加成。
DA_HoldTheLine.desc_en: Champions in your back 2 rows gain 10% Ability Power and 9% Attack Damage for each champion that starts combat in your front row.

DA_Hustler.name: 花到上头
DA_Hustler.desc: 你不再获得利息，但会在每个玩家对战回合开始时获得3金币。立刻获得3金币。 10
DA_Hustler.desc_en: You no longer gain interest but gain 3 gold at the start of every player combat round. Gain 3 gold now. 10

DA_InfinityProtection.name: 三相庇护
DA_InfinityProtection.desc: 立刻获得3金币。在3-7回合，获得1个【三相之力】。【三相之力】为同一排的友军提供12%生命值护盾。
DA_InfinityProtection.desc_en: Gain 3 gold now. On Stage 3-7, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a 12% Health shield.

DA_InvestedPlus.name: 投资+
DA_InvestedPlus.desc: 获得26金币。在每回合开始时，超过50金币后，每拥有10金币就会获得1次商店刷新(最多80金币)。
DA_InvestedPlus.desc_en: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

DA_InvestedPlusPlus.name: 投资++
DA_InvestedPlusPlus.desc: 获得45金币。在每回合开始时，超过50金币后，每拥有10金币就会获得1次商店刷新(最多80金币)。
DA_InvestedPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

DA_InvestmentStrategy.name: 投资策略 II
DA_InvestmentStrategy.desc: 你每获得1利息，你弈子们获得10永久最大生命值。你的最大利息提升2。立刻获得8金币。
DA_InvestmentStrategy.desc_en: Your champions gain 10 permanent max health per interest you earn. Your max interest is increased by 2. Gain 8 gold now.

DA_InvestmentStrategyI.name: 投资策略 I
DA_InvestmentStrategyI.desc: 你每获得1利息，你弈子们获得8永久最大生命值。立刻获得4金币。
DA_InvestmentStrategyI.desc_en: Your champions gain 8 permanent max health per interest you earn. Gain 4 gold now.

DA_IronAssets.name: 黑铁资产
DA_IronAssets.desc: 获得1个【基础装备锻造器】和3金币。
DA_IronAssets.desc_en: Gain a component anvil and 3 gold.

DA_JeweledLotus_I.name: 珠光莲花 I
DA_JeweledLotus_I.desc: 你的队伍获得10%暴击几率和技能暴击。
DA_JeweledLotus_I.desc_en: Your team gains 10% Critical Strike Chance and Precision.

DA_JeweledLotus_II.name: 珠光莲花 II
DA_JeweledLotus_II.desc: 你的队伍获得25%暴击几率，10%暴击伤害和【技能暴击】。
DA_JeweledLotus_II.desc_en: Your team gains 25% Critical Strike Chance, 10% Critical Strike Damage, and Precision.

DA_KickStart.name: 博弈开启
DA_KickStart.desc: 获得1个随机2星2费弈子和1金币。
DA_KickStart.desc_en: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and 1 gold.

DA_Kingslayer.name: 弑君突刺
DA_Kingslayer.desc: 在赢得玩家对战回合后，获得1金币。如果这位玩家之前的生命值多于你的生命值，转而获得6金币。获得1金币。
DA_Kingslayer.desc_en: After winning player combat, gain 1 gold. If they had more health than you, gain 6 Gold instead. Gain 1 gold.

DA_LateGameScaling.name: 后期收益
DA_LateGameScaling.desc: 在每场玩家战斗回合开始时，获得2经验值。你的5费弈子们获得12%生命值和12%攻击速度。
DA_LateGameScaling.desc_en: Gain 2 XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain 12% Health and 12% Attack Speed.

DA_LateGameSpecialist.name: 后期专家
DA_LateGameSpecialist.desc: 当你到达9级时，获得27金币。
DA_LateGameSpecialist.desc_en: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

DA_LatentForge.name: 休眠锻炉
DA_LatentForge.desc: 在8场玩家对战回合后，获得1个【神器锻造器】。
DA_LatentForge.desc_en: After 8 player combats, gain an Artifact anvil.

DA_LegionOfThrees.name: 三幻神
DA_LegionOfThrees.desc: 获得1个随机纹章。你的3费弈子们和携带着纹章的友军获得150生命值和12%攻击速度。
DA_LegionOfThrees.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain 150 Health and 12% Attack Speed.

DA_LevelUp.name: 升级咯！
DA_LevelUp.desc: 在你购买经验值时，获得额外2经验值。立刻获得6经验值。
DA_LevelUp.desc_en: When you buy XP, gain an additional 2. Gain 6 immediately.

DA_LivingForge.name: 活体锻炉
DA_LivingForge.desc: 立刻以及每10场玩家对战回合后，获得1个【神器锻造器】。
DA_LivingForge.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 10 player combats.

DA_LoadedDice.name: 灌铅骰子
DA_LoadedDice.desc: 你在投掷骰子或抛掷硬币时总能更幸运。 投掷1个骰子，获得与点数相等的金币。然后抛掷1枚硬币，如果硬币正面朝上，获得1金币。
DA_LoadedDice.desc_en: Your dice and coins are luckier. Roll a die and gain gold equal to the number rolled. Then flip a coin and gain 1 gold if you flip heads.

DA_LuckyGloves.name: 幸运手套
DA_LuckyGloves.desc: 【窃贼手套】总会为你的弈子们提供理想的装备。获得2个【拳套】和4金币。
DA_LuckyGloves.desc_en: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and 4 gold.

DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.name: 幸运手套+
DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.desc: 【窃贼手套】总会为你的弈子们提供理想的装备。立刻获得2个【拳套】，然后在4场玩家对战回合后获得另一个。
DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.desc_en: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves now, then another after 4 player combats.

DA_LuxurySubscription.name: 奢侈品订购
DA_LuxurySubscription.desc: 获得1个包裹，包含1个5费弈子、1个2星1费弈子和3金币。 在接下来的2个阶段开始时，再次获得该包裹。
DA_LuxurySubscription.desc_en: Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 3 gold. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

DA_MagicRoll.name: 魔法投掷
DA_MagicRoll.desc: 投掷3个骰子。基于总点数获得奖励。
DA_MagicRoll.desc_en: Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

DA_MakeshiftArmorI.name: 应急护甲 I
DA_MakeshiftArmorI.desc: 没有携带任何装备的弈子获得30护甲和魔抗。
DA_MakeshiftArmorI.desc_en: Champions without items equipped gain 30 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MakeshiftArmorII.name: 应急护甲 II
DA_MakeshiftArmorII.desc: 没有携带任何装备的弈子获得50护甲和魔抗。
DA_MakeshiftArmorII.desc_en: Champions without items equipped gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MaliciousMonetization.name: 恶意货币化
DA_MaliciousMonetization.desc: 获得4金币。接下来的2个回合，敌方弈子在被击杀时会掉落2金币。
DA_MaliciousMonetization.desc_en: Gain 4 gold. For the next 2 rounds, enemy champions drop 2 gold when killed.

DA_MaxBuild.name: 顶尖构筑
DA_MaxBuild.desc: 获得10次免费商店刷新。当你到达9级时，获得3次免费商店刷新和1个【英雄复制器】。
DA_MaxBuild.desc_en: Gain 10 free Shop rerolls. When you reach level 9, gain 3 free Shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator.

DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.name: 贪财
DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.desc: 立刻获得7金币，然后在每阶段开始时获得7金币。拾取金币会令你的小小英雄变大。
DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.desc_en: Gain 7 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyHungryPlus.name: 贪财+
DA_MoneyHungryPlus.desc: 立刻获得13金币，然后在每阶段开始时获得7金币。拾取金币会令你的小小英雄变大。
DA_MoneyHungryPlus.desc_en: Gain 13 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyMonsoon.name: 摇钱树
DA_MoneyMonsoon.desc: 立刻并在剩余游戏时间内每回合获得7金币。
DA_MoneyMonsoon.desc_en: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

DA_NestingAnvils.name: 锻造器套娃
DA_NestingAnvils.desc: 获得1个【神器锻造器】。在你开启它之后，获得1个【基础装备锻造器】。开启这个【基础装备锻造器】后，又获得4金币。
DA_NestingAnvils.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 4 gold.

DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.name: 锻造器套娃+
DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.desc: 获得1个【神器锻造器】。在你开启它之后，获得1个【基础装备锻造器】。开启这个【基础装备锻造器】后，又获得8金币。
DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 8 gold.

DA_NoScoutNoPivot.name: 不侦察，不变阵
DA_NoScoutNoPivot.desc: 参与玩家对战回合后，弈子无法再回到备战席或出售。在玩家对战回合后，你的队伍获得1%生命值、1%物理加成和法术加成。
DA_NoScoutNoPivot.desc_en: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains 1% Health, and 1% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

DA_OneBuffTwoBuff.name: 1个霸符，2个霸符
DA_OneBuffTwoBuff.desc: 获得1个【红霸符】、1个【蓝霸符】和1个【英雄复制器】。
DA_OneBuffTwoBuff.desc_en: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

DA_18_OnesTwosThree.name: 一一二三
DA_18_OnesTwosThree.desc: 获得2个1费弈子、1个2费弈子和1个3费弈子。

DA_18_OneTwoFive.name: 一，二，五！
DA_18_OneTwoFive.desc: 获得1件随机基础装备、2金币和1个随机5费弈子。
DA_18_OneTwoFive.desc_en: Gain 1 random component, 2 gold, and 1 random 5-cost champion.

DA_PandorasItemsI.name: 潘朵拉的装备 I
DA_PandorasItemsI.desc: 回合开始时：你备战席的装备会随机变化。 获得1件随机基础装备。
DA_PandorasItemsI.desc_en: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 random component.

DA_PandorasItemsII.name: 潘朵拉的装备 II
DA_PandorasItemsII.desc: 回合开始时：你备战席的装备会随机变化。 获得2件随机基础装备。
DA_PandorasItemsII.desc_en: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 2 random components.

DA_PandorasItemsIII.name: 潘朵拉的装备 III
DA_PandorasItemsIII.desc: 回合开始时：你备战席的装备会随机变化。 获得1件光明武器。
DA_PandorasItemsIII.desc_en: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 Radiant item.

DA_PartialAscension.name: 部分飞升
DA_PartialAscension.desc: 在战斗开始12秒后，你的单位们获得20%伤害增幅。
DA_PartialAscension.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.name: 耐心是一种美德
DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.desc: 立刻获得4次刷新。每回合，如果你在上回合未购买任何弈子，则会获得1次免费刷新。
DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.desc_en: Gain 4 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

DA_PatientStudy.name: 耐心学习
DA_PatientStudy.desc: 在玩家对战回合后，如果你赢了则获得2经验值，如果你输了则获得3经验值。
DA_PatientStudy.desc_en: After player combat, gain 2 XP if you won or 3 XP if you lost.

DA_Pilfer.name: 挖角
DA_Pilfer.desc: 每回合，获得你在上场对战中首先击杀的那个弈子的1个1星复制体。当你通过这种方式获得的弈子总价值达到21金币时，获得1个【窃贼手套】。
DA_Pilfer.desc_en: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 21 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

DA_PortableForge.name: 便携锻炉
DA_PortableForge.desc: 在4件神器中选择1件。神器是可以提供独特效果的强力装备。
DA_PortableForge.desc_en: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

DA_PrismaticTicket.name: 棱彩门票
DA_PrismaticTicket.desc: 每当你的商店刷新时，你都有45%几率获得1次免费刷新。
DA_PrismaticTicket.desc_en: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

DA_PromisedProtection.name: 承诺之护
DA_PromisedProtection.desc: 获得1个【圣盾使的誓约】。【圣盾使的誓约】为其携带者提供自所有来源的20%额外法力值和200最大生命值。
DA_PromisedProtection.desc_en: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 200 max Health.

DA_QuickStreaks.name: 连败连胜才能连鸡
DA_QuickStreaks.desc: 你现在赢得或输掉对战后，增加的连胜或连败数翻倍。获得2金币。
DA_QuickStreaks.desc_en: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

DA_RadiantRascal.name: 光明无赖
DA_RadiantRascal.desc: 获得1个【光明版窃贼手套】。每回合装备2件随机光明武器。
DA_RadiantRascal.desc_en: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

DA_RadiantRelic.name: 光明圣物
DA_RadiantRelic.desc: 从5件光明武器中选择1件。获得1个【装备拆卸器】。
DA_RadiantRelic.desc_en: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_Recombobulator.name: 变形重组器
DA_Recombobulator.desc: 你棋盘上的弈子们永久变形为1个比自身高1费的随机弈子(最高5费)。获得2个【装备拆卸器】和3次免费刷新。
DA_Recombobulator.desc_en: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers and 3 free rerolls.

DA_Replication.name: 反响
DA_Replication.desc: 在3件基础装备中选择1件。在接下来的2个回合，都会获得1件该基础装备。
DA_Replication.desc_en: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

DA_18_ResidualMagic.name: 残留魔力
DA_18_ResidualMagic.desc: 你的队伍获得60生命值。你每次购买【自然仙灵】，都会将该加成提升10。
DA_18_ResidualMagic.desc_en: Your team gains 60 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

DA_18_ResidualMagicPlus.name: 残留魔力+
DA_18_ResidualMagicPlus.desc: 你的队伍获得75生命值。你每次购买【自然仙灵】，都会将该加成提升10。
DA_18_ResidualMagicPlus.desc_en: Your team gains 75 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

DA_18_ResidualMagicPlusPlus.name: 残留魔力++
DA_18_ResidualMagicPlusPlus.desc: 你的队伍获得90生命值。你每次购买【自然仙灵】，都会将该加成提升10。
DA_18_ResidualMagicPlusPlus.desc_en: Your team gains 90 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

DA_Retribution.name: 正义报复
DA_Retribution.desc: 获得2个【正义之手】。携带【正义之手】的友军获得技能暴击和25%暴击几率。
DA_Retribution.desc_en: Gain 2 Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and 25% Critical Strike Chance.

DA_18_RiftbeastTraitAugment.name: 欧米茄之怪
DA_18_RiftbeastTraitAugment.desc: 你现在可以选择第二个被【阿尔法印记】标记的【峡谷野怪】。获得1个【峡谷迅捷蟹】、1个【绯红树怪】和1个【苍蓝哨戒】。
DA_18_RiftbeastTraitAugment.desc_en: You can now choose a second Alpha Riftbeast. Gain a Scuttlecrab, a Cinderling, and a Pebbles.

DA_18_RivalsAugment.name: 世纪和解
DA_18_RivalsAugment.desc: 你可以同时登场【雷恩加尔】和【卡兹克】且不触发【宿敌】羁绊的负面效果。他们会在彼此施放技能时获得加成。获得1个【雷恩加尔】和1个【卡兹克】。
DA_18_RivalsAugment.desc_en: You can field Rengar and Kha'Zix together with no penalties, and they gain bonuses when the other casts. Gain a Rengar and a Kha'Zix.

DA_SalvageBin.name: 打捞桶
DA_SalvageBin.desc: 立刻获得1件随机成装，并在8场玩家对战回合后获得1件基础装备。出售弈子会将其携带的成装拆分成基础装备(冠冕系装备和纹章除外)。
DA_SalvageBin.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SalvageBinPlus.name: 打捞桶+
DA_SalvageBinPlus.desc: 立刻获得1件随机成装，并在4场玩家对战回合后获得1件基础装备。出售弈子会将其携带的成装拆分成基础装备(冠冕系装备和纹章除外)。
DA_SalvageBinPlus.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SeraphimsStaff.name: 炽天使之拥
DA_SeraphimsStaff.desc: 获得1个【大天使之杖】。如果【大天使之杖】的携带者拥有90%或以上的法术加成，【大天使之杖】还会为其额外提供2法力回复。
DA_SeraphimsStaff.desc_en: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants 2 additional Mana Regen if its holder has 90% or more Ability Power.

DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.name: 金鳞精萃
DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.desc: 获得1个【投机者之刃】。在6场玩家对战回合后，获得1个【大亨之铠】。
DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.desc_en: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After 6 player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

DA_ShoppingSpree.name: 大买特买
DA_ShoppingSpree.desc: 在你升级时，获得相当于你等级数+1的商店刷新次数。获得6金币。
DA_ShoppingSpree.desc_en: When you level up, gain a number of Shop refreshes equal to your level +1. Gain 6 gold.

DA_Slammin.name: 物尽其用
DA_Slammin.desc: 获得3金币。在每场玩家对战回合结束时，如果你的备战席没有任何装备(消耗品除外)，获得2经验值。
DA_Slammin.desc_en: Gain 3 gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_SlamminPlus.name: 物尽其用+
DA_SlamminPlus.desc: 立刻获得4金币和10经验值。在每场玩家对战回合结束时，如果你的备战席没有任何装备(消耗品除外)，获得2经验值。
DA_SlamminPlus.desc_en: Gain 4 gold and 10 XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_SliceOfLife.name: 人生切片
DA_SliceOfLife.desc: 每阶段2次，获得1个随机弈子。其费用会随阶段数提升。这个效果会在收到1个5费弈子后结束。
DA_SliceOfLife.desc_en: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.name: 轻量魔法投掷
DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.desc: 投掷1个骰子。基于总点数获得奖励。
DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.desc_en: Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

DA_SoloLeveling.name: 独自升级
DA_SoloLeveling.desc: 在接下来的5场对战，你的队伍规模为1，但你登场的那个弈子拥有巨幅提升过的各属性。该弈子的每次击杀都会使你获得1经验值。在此之后，获得2件基础装备。
DA_SoloLeveling.desc_en: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

DA_SoloPlate.name: 单身板甲
DA_SoloPlate.desc: 获得1个【石像鬼石板甲】。战斗开始时：如果友军是所在排的唯一弈子并携带了【石像鬼石板甲】，该弈子获得17%最大生命值。
DA_SoloPlate.desc_en: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 17% max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

DA_SoulAwakening.name: 灵魂唤醒
DA_SoulAwakening.desc: 战斗开始时：你的队伍每秒获得1.5%物理加成和法术加成，持续10秒。在最大层数时，造成12%额外真实伤害。
DA_SoulAwakening.desc_en: Combat start: Your team gains 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for 10 seconds. At max stacks, deal 12% bonus true damage.

DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.name: 一波带走俩
DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.desc: 获得1个【鬼索的狂暴之刃】。当2名玩家淘汰后，获得40金币。
DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.desc_en: Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain 40 gold.

DA_SpiritOfRedemption.name: 救赎盔甲
DA_SpiritOfRedemption.desc: 获得1个【振奋盔甲】。每5秒，【振奋盔甲】会治疗1格内的友军7.5%已损失生命值。
DA_SpiritOfRedemption.desc_en: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every 5 seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within 1 hex for 7.5% of their missing Health.

DA_SpreadingRoots.name: 蔓延之根
DA_SpreadingRoots.desc: 获得一个随机纹章。在3场玩家对战回合后，获得另一个。
DA_SpreadingRoots.desc_en: Gain a random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

DA_SpreadingRootsPlus.name: 蔓延之根+
DA_SpreadingRootsPlus.desc: 获得2个随机纹章和2金币。

DA_Staffsmith.name: 杖之工匠
DA_Staffsmith.desc: 获得2件由【无用大棒】合成的随机成装。
DA_Staffsmith.desc_en: Gain 2 random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

DA_StandUnited.name: 联合作战
DA_StandUnited.desc: 在你的队伍之中，每有1个已激活的非唯一羁绊，你的单位们就会获得1.5%物理加成和1.5%法术加成。
DA_StandUnited.desc_en: Your units gain 1.5% Attack Damage and 1.5% Ability Power for each non-unique Trait active across your team.

DA_SweetTreats.name: 甜点
DA_SweetTreats.desc: 获得1个【神器锻造器】。你的弈子们每携带1件装备，你的队伍就会获得16生命值。
DA_SweetTreats.desc_en: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains 16 Health for each item equipped on champions.

DA_SwordOverflow.name: 大剑溢流
DA_SwordOverflow.desc: 获得4个【暴风大剑】。你的【暴风大剑】提供+4攻击速度。
DA_SwordOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant +4% Attack Speed.

DA_Swordsmith.name: 剑之工匠
DA_Swordsmith.desc: 获得2件由【暴风大剑】合成的随机成装。
DA_Swordsmith.desc_en: Gain 2 random completed items that build from B.F. Sword.

DA_TacticiansKitchen.name: 锅铲厨房
DA_TacticiansKitchen.desc: 获得1个随机纹章。在3个回合后，获得1个【金锅铲冠冕】。
DA_TacticiansKitchen.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

DA_TeamBuilding.name: 团队建设
DA_TeamBuilding.desc: 获得1个【次级英雄复制器】。在5场玩家对战回合后获得另一个。
DA_TeamBuilding.desc_en: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats.

DA_TheGoldenDragon.name: 金霖龙
DA_TheGoldenDragon.desc: 获得1个【大亨之铠】。携带【大亨之铠】的弈子们占用1个弈子栏位，但获得600生命值和15%伤害减免。
DA_TheGoldenDragon.desc_en: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +1 team slot but gain 600 Health and 15% Durability.

DA_TheTower.name: 高塔
DA_TheTower.desc: 获得1个巨大的【训练假人】。每4秒，电击距离最近的3个敌人，造成5%最大生命值的真实伤害。
DA_TheTower.desc_en: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

DA_TheTraitTree.name: 羁绊树
DA_TheTraitTree.desc: 获得3个随机纹章和2金币。

DA_TheTraitTreePlus.name: 羁绊树+
DA_TheTraitTreePlus.desc: 获得3个随机纹章、1个【装备重铸器】和4金币。
DA_TheTraitTreePlus.desc_en: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

DA_TimeSkip.name: 时间跳跃
DA_TimeSkip.desc: 在接下来的3个回合中禁用你的商店。然后获得32经验值。
DA_TimeSkip.desc_en: Disable your Shop for the next 3 rounds. Then gain 32 XP.

DA_TonsOfStatsI.name: 成吨的属性
DA_TonsOfStatsI.desc: 你的队伍获得44生命值、4%物理加成、4%法术加成、4护甲、4魔法抗性、4%攻击速度和4法力值。
DA_TonsOfStatsI.desc_en: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

DA_TonsOfStatsII.name: 成吨的属性！
DA_TonsOfStatsII.desc: 你的队伍获得88生命值、8%物理加成、8%法术加成、8护甲、8魔法抗性、8%攻击速度和8法力值。
DA_TonsOfStatsII.desc_en: Your team gains 88 Health, 8% Attack Damage, 8% Ability Power, 8 Armor, 8 Magic Resist, 8% Attack Speed, and 8 Mana.

DA_TradeSector.name: DD街区
DA_TradeSector.desc: 每回合获得1次商店刷新。获得2金币。
DA_TradeSector.desc_en: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

DA_TradeSectorPlus.name: DD街区+
DA_TradeSectorPlus.desc: 每回合获得1次商店刷新。获得8金币。
DA_TradeSectorPlus.desc_en: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 8 gold.

DA_TraitLadder.name: 羁绊天梯
DA_TraitLadder.desc: 获得1个随机纹章。在1场玩家对战回合中登场2个非唯一羁绊后，获得1个奖励。此后提高获得奖励所需的羁绊数，以及奖励的规模。
DA_TraitLadder.desc_en: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

DA_TwinGuardians.name: 双子守护神
DA_TwinGuardians.desc: 如果你的第一排有且只有2名友军，为他们提供100生命值、35护甲和35魔法抗性。
DA_TwinGuardians.desc_en: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 100 Health, 35 Armor, and 35 Magic Resist.

DA_UpwardMobility.name: 上进心
DA_UpwardMobility.desc: 购买经验值的费用减少1。每当你升级时，获得2生命值和2次刷新。
DA_UpwardMobility.desc_en: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 2 Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

DA_URF.name: 厨神阿福
DA_URF.desc: 获得1个【金铲铲】。携带了【金铲铲】或【金锅锅】系装备的弈子们获得20%攻击速度和3法力回复。
DA_URF.desc_en: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 20% Attack Speed and 3 Mana Regen.

DA_UrfsGrabBag.name: 阿福的百宝袋
DA_UrfsGrabBag.desc: 获得1个【金铲铲】、3件随机基础装备和5金币。
DA_UrfsGrabBag.desc_en: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

DA_VerticalityI.name: 纵深 I
DA_VerticalityI.desc: 每有1名拥有相同羁绊的友军，这些弈子们就会获得1.5%物理加成、1.5%法术加成、1.5护甲和1.5魔法抗性。
DA_VerticalityI.desc_en: Champions gain 1.5% Attack Damage, 1.5% Ability Power, 1.5 Armor, and 1.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityII.name: 纵深 II
DA_VerticalityII.desc: 每有1名拥有相同羁绊的友军，这些弈子们就会获得2%物理加成、2%法术加成、2护甲和2魔法抗性。
DA_VerticalityII.desc_en: Champions gain 2% Attack Damage, 2% Ability Power, 2 Armor, and 2 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityIII.name: 纵深 III
DA_VerticalityIII.desc: 每有1名拥有相同羁绊的友军，这些弈子们就会获得3.5%物理加成、3.5%法术加成、3.5护甲和3.5魔法抗性。
DA_VerticalityIII.desc_en: Champions gain 3.5% Attack Damage, 3.5% Ability Power, 3.5 Armor, and 3.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_WandOverflow.name: 法杖溢流
DA_WandOverflow.desc: 获得4个【无用大棒】。你的【无用大棒】提供+5攻击速度。
DA_WandOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

DA_Warpath.name: 征战之路
DA_Warpath.desc: 获得1个2星2费弈子。在造成80玩家伤害后，获得1个装有高费弈子们和装备的宝箱。
DA_Warpath.desc_en: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

DA_18_WeightTheWorth.name: 等待得值
DA_18_WeightTheWorth.desc: 每当你将1个弈子升至3星时，在剩余游戏时间内的每回合都会获得1个其1星复制体。将与该弈子相同的弈子再次升至3星时，提供额外的1星复制体。获得1个【次级英雄复制器】。
DA_18_WeightTheWorth.desc_en: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

DA_WeStickTogether.name: 水乳交融
DA_WeStickTogether.desc: 获得1个随机纹章和1个【成装锻造器】。与该纹章有同一羁绊的友军获得30%攻击速度。0 0
DA_WeStickTogether.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain 30% Attack Speed. 0 0

DA_18_WispRebatePlus.name: 仙灵报恩
DA_18_WispRebatePlus.desc: 你每次购买【自然仙灵】，都会获得2金币。立刻获得4金币。
DA_18_WispRebatePlus.desc_en: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 4 gold now.

DA_18_WispRebatePlusPlus.name: 仙灵报恩+
DA_18_WispRebatePlusPlus.desc: 你每次购买【自然仙灵】，都会获得2金币。立刻获得8金币。
DA_18_WispRebatePlusPlus.desc_en: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 8 gold now.

DA_WorththeWait.name: 值得等待
DA_WorththeWait.desc: 获得1个随机1费弈子。每回合开始时都会获得该弈子的又一个1星复制体，持续至本局游戏结束。
DA_WorththeWait.desc_en: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_WorththeWaitII.name: 值得等待 II
DA_WorththeWaitII.desc: 获得1个随机2费弈子的2个1星复制体。每回合开始时都会获得该弈子的又一个1星复制体，持续至本局游戏结束。
DA_WorththeWaitII.desc_en: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_WovenMagic.name: 纺织魔法
DA_WovenMagic.desc: 获得1件随机基础装备。你的弈子们每消耗2200法力值，就会提供1件额外基础装备(最大：0/3)。
DA_WovenMagic.desc_en: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component (max: 0/3).

DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.name: 不拘一格
DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.desc: 选秀环节期间，你可自由移动。获得5金币。
DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.desc_en: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.

DA_18_CovenTraitAugment_LootToAP.name: 黑暗仪式
DA_18_CovenTraitAugment_LootToAP.desc: 将【魔女精粹】兑换为奖励时，不再提供战利品，而是为【魔女】弈子们提供法术加成。获得1个【卡蜜尔】、1个【伊莉丝】和1个【凯特琳】。
DA_18_CovenTraitAugment_LootToAP.desc_en: Converting Coven Essence to rewards grants Coven champions Ability Power instead of loot. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.name: 源计划植入
DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.desc: 你携带1件装备的弈子们获得100生命值和15%物理加成。获得1个【暴风大剑】。
DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.desc_en: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 15% Attack Damage. Gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.name: 源计划上行链路
DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.desc: 你携带1件装备的弈子们获得100生命值和2法力回复。获得1个【女神之泪】。
DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.desc_en: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 2 Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

DA_18_LunarTraitAugment.name: 日月同辉
DA_18_LunarTraitAugment.desc: 每登场1个不同的【日蚀骑士】弈子，你的【月蚀骑士】弈子们获得100生命值和8%伤害增幅。获得1个【蕾欧娜】、1个【凯尔】和1个【厄斐琉斯】。
DA_18_LunarTraitAugment.desc_en: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Diana.

DA_18_LunarTraitAugmentPlus.name: 日月同辉＋
DA_18_LunarTraitAugmentPlus.desc: 每登场1个不同的【日蚀骑士】弈子，你的【月蚀骑士】弈子们获得100生命值和8%伤害增幅。获得1个【蕾欧娜】、1个【凯尔】和1个【厄斐琉斯】。
DA_18_LunarTraitAugmentPlus.desc_en: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and an Aphelios.

DA_18_SolarTraitAugment.name: 太阳的抉择
DA_18_SolarTraitAugment.desc: 获得1个【蕾欧娜】、1个【凯尔】和1个【瑟庄妮】。【蕾欧娜】每回合获得70永久最大生命值，每登场1名不同的3星弈子，该加成还会提升10。
DA_18_SolarTraitAugment.desc_en: Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Sejuani. Leona gains 70 permanent max Health each round, increased by 10 for each unique 3-star champion fielded.

DA_PlotArmor.name: 应急护盾
DA_PlotArmor.desc: 你的队伍获得8护甲和魔法抗性。在生命值降至50%以下时，这个加成提升至40，持续至战斗结束。
DA_PlotArmor.desc_en: Your team gains 8 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 50% Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

DA_18_PrimalAugment_Nidalee.name: 兽性本能
DA_18_PrimalAugment_Nidalee.desc: 【野兽之灵】额外提供一种【兽灵赐福】。立刻获得1个【蔚】，在3个回合后，获得1个【奈德丽】。
DA_18_PrimalAugment_Nidalee.desc_en: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi now and a Nidalee after 3 rounds.

DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Nidalee.name: 兽性本能+
DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Nidalee.desc: 【野兽之灵】额外提供一种【兽灵赐福】。获得1个【蔚】和1个【奈德丽】。
DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Nidalee.desc_en: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Nidalee.

DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Sivir.name: 兽性本能+
DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Sivir.desc: 【野兽之灵】额外提供一种【兽灵赐福】。获得1个【蔚】和1个【希维尔】。
DA_18_PrimalAugmentPlus_Sivir.desc_en: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Sivir.

DA_18_PrimalAugment_Sivir.name: 兽性本能
DA_18_PrimalAugment_Sivir.desc: 【野兽之灵】额外提供一种【兽灵赐福】。立刻获得1个【蔚】，在3个回合后，获得1个【希维尔】。
DA_18_PrimalAugment_Sivir.desc_en: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi now and a Sivir after 3 rounds.

DA_NestingDollsPlus.name: 弈子套娃
DA_NestingDollsPlus.desc: 当1个弈子在战斗中阵亡后，召唤1个降低1星的复制体，其生命值只有60%。获得3次免费重随。
DA_NestingDollsPlus.desc_en: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with 60% health. Gain 3 free rerolls.

DA_NestingDollsPlusPlus.name: 弈子套娃
DA_NestingDollsPlusPlus.desc: 当1个弈子在战斗中阵亡后，召唤1个降低1星的复制体，其生命值只有60%。获得3次免费重随。
DA_NestingDollsPlusPlus.desc_en: After a champion dies in combat, spawn a copy of them one star level lower with 60% health. Gain 3 free rerolls.

DA_ItsMeBaby.name: 是我，宝贝！
DA_ItsMeBaby.desc: 棋盘的右下角出现1个【冠军格】。在其中的弈子获得15%伤害增幅和15%攻击速度，并且其每参与5次击杀就会掉落1金币。
DA_ItsMeBaby.desc_en: Gain a championship hex in the bottom right corner. The champion in it gains 15% Damage Amp and 15% Attack Speed, and drops 1 gold every 5 takedowns.

DA_PandorasBench.name: 潘朵拉的备战席
DA_PandorasBench.desc: 在每回合开始时，处在备战席最右侧3个栏位的弈子变为随机的同费用弈子。获得4金币。
DA_PandorasBench.desc_en: At the start of every round, champions on the 3 rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain 4 gold.

DA_DeadlierCaps.name: 更要命的帽子
DA_DeadlierCaps.desc: 获得1个【灭世者的死亡之帽】。【灭世者的死亡之帽】提供1法力回复，并且它的携带者每参与击杀一次，它就会永久获得1%法术加成。
DA_DeadlierCaps.desc_en: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant 1 Mana Regen and permanently gain 1% Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_18_LuxAugmentII.name: 创世神
DA_18_LuxAugmentII.desc: 开启1个武器库，并在3个羁绊选项中选择1个。获得1个该羁绊的【拉克丝】和1个【朔极之矛】。 你棋盘上的羁绊会更有可能出现在该武器库中。【拉克丝】为她选定的羁绊提供+2计数。
DA_18_LuxAugmentII.desc_en: Open an armory and choose one of 3 traits. Gain a Lux with that trait and a Spear of Shojin. Traits on your board are more likely to appear in the armory. Lux provides +2 to her chosen trait

DA_GoldDestiny.name: 黄金命运
DA_GoldDestiny.desc: 获得1个随机黄金阶强化符文和3金币。
DA_GoldDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Gold Augment and 3 gold.

DA_GoldDestinyPlus.name: 黄金命运+
DA_GoldDestinyPlus.desc: 获得1个随机黄金阶强化符文和5金币。
DA_GoldDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Gold Augment and 5 gold.

DA_Min_Max.name: 可大可小
DA_Min_Max.desc: 获得1个【金制拆卸器】和4件随机基础装备。
DA_Min_Max.desc_en: Gain a Golden Item Remover and 4 random components.

DA_MissedConnections.name: 别再错过
DA_MissedConnections.desc_en: Gain a copy of each 1-cost champion.

DA_PrismaticDestiny.name: 棱彩命运
DA_PrismaticDestiny.desc: 获得1个随机棱彩阶强化符文和4金币。
DA_PrismaticDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 4 gold.

DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.name: 棱彩命运+
DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.desc: 获得1个随机棱彩阶强化符文和7金币。
DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 7 gold.

DA_SilverDestiny.name: 白银命运
DA_SilverDestiny.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和2金币。
DA_SilverDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlus.name: 白银命运+
DA_SilverDestinyPlus.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和4金币。
DA_SilverDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.name: 白银命运++
DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和7金币。
DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

DA_18_SprykinAugment.name: 毛茸茸小朋友
DA_18_SprykinAugment.desc: 当【约德尔人和他们的毛茸茸大朋友】羁绊激活时，获得第二个【毛茸茸大朋友】召唤物，但仅有原来的35%强度。获得1个【提莫】、1个【维迦】和1个【可酷伯】。
DA_18_SprykinAugment.desc_en: While Sprykin is active, gain a second BFF summon that is 35% as powerful. Gain a Teemo, a Veigar, and a Kobuko.

DA_BuildABud.name: 来个好伙计！
DA_BuildABud.desc: 获得1个随机3星1费弈子。获得6金币。
DA_BuildABud.desc_en: Gain a random 3-star 1-cost champion. Gain 6 gold.

DA_KnowYourEnemy.name: 了解你的敌人
DA_KnowYourEnemy.desc: 你可以看到你下回合将要和谁战斗。你的队伍获得8%伤害增幅。如果你和你的对手有任何相同的已激活羁绊，转而获得15%伤害增幅。
DA_KnowYourEnemy.desc_en: You can see who you will fight next. Your team gains 8% Damage Amp, increased to 15% if you and your opponent have any of the same traits active.

DA_18_InfernoTraitAugment.name: 烧起来
DA_18_InfernoTraitAugment.desc: 你的1费和2费【地狱火】弈子们获得0.2物理加成和法术加成。这些弈子中，在上场对战中造成最高伤害的那个弈子将会获得双倍此加成。获得1个【韦鲁斯】和1个【阿卡丽】。
DA_18_InfernoTraitAugment.desc_en: Your 1 and 2-cost Inferno champions gain 0.2 Attack Damage and Ability Power. The one who did the most damage last combat gains double. Gain a Varus and an Akali.

DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.name: 意料之中的意外
DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.desc: 立刻以及下2个阶段开始时，投掷3个骰子。基于总点数获得各种奖励。
DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.desc_en: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.
